detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A mashup of two classics

Sokogram merges Nonogram logic grids with Sokoban box-pushing puzzles. Instead of coloring in a picture, the Nonogram clues guide you in drawing a path across the grid. Solve puzzles by finding a path that satisfies the clues while allowing every box to reach its goal. Each handcrafted puzzle has a unique solution that can only be found by combining both rulesets.

There might be many paths that fulfill the Nonogram requirements but only one represents a solvable Sokoban puzzle. Once the drawing is complete, every box must be pushed into place to confirm your solution.

More than just boxes

Later puzzles introduce new mechanics such as rolling snowballs, placeable obstacles like rocks and tree stumps, and quirky creatures like leaping frogs or scaredy bats.

Features

  • Nonogram meets Sokoban - Draw on a Nonogram grid while planning Sokoban moves

  • Intertwined logic - You’re not solving two separate puzzles but one unified challenge

  • Handcrafted puzzles - More than 150 puzzles with unique solutions

  • Non-linear progression - Choose puzzles in an overworld that expands as you progress

  • Hint system - In case you get stuck...
